summary: Weekly stock case studies combine bottom/reclaim and neckline-break signals with equal-distance price targets, then reverse to shorts when triangle or head-and-shoulders tops break their necklines (PDF pp182–191). The cases are the continuation of 茂矽, 台积电, 金宝, 友达, and the beginning of 光磊; stops generally use the reclaimed/broken neckline or the signal candle's extreme, while base duration distinguishes a short rebound from a substantial bull swing (pp182–191). Multiple measured-move targets are conditional on renewed breakouts after consolidation, not automatic promises, and the text stresses patience because clear weekly opportunities are infrequent (pp182–186, 188, 191).

patterns.structure: A base first undercuts its previous floor, then a large bullish weekly candle reclaims the base neckline. 台积电 breaks the floor in the week of 1998-08-29 and reclaims on 1998-11-21 (p183); 友达 reclaims its earlier range floor at 10.68 after a low at 9.88 (pp189–190).
patterns.entry: Enter when the reclaim establishes the bottom; 台积电 around 13.3 on 1998-11-21 (p185). 友达's trading paragraph gives a daily reclaim on 2003-05-26 and a next-day entry around 11.6, with the weekly bullish reclaim dated May 31 (p190); p189 prints a conflicting year, retained in ambiguities.
patterns.stop: 台积电: below 12.5, the large bullish week's low, risk about 6% (p185). 友达: below the pre-breakdown floor 10.68, identified as the main player's cost-area floor, risk about 8% (p190).

target.formula: After a later break of the preceding swing high, project the first rise's distance upward from the correction low; this is not a target computed from the reclaim candle itself.

confirmation: 台积电 uses a volume-backed long bullish weekly candle reclaiming the neckline (pp183, 185).
友达's weekly May 31 candle closes bullish above the neckline after the daily reclaim (p190).
The later prior-high breakout permits calculating the large-swing upside target (pp183, 189).
invalidation: Break the specified reclaimed support or signal-candle low and stop (pp185, 190).
金宝's early-2001 reclaim base lasts only a little over two months versus a top lasting over ten months, so it is treated as a rebound, not an established large bull swing (pp187–188).
timeframes: daily entry timing within a weekly case (友达, p190)

patterns.name_zh: 收敛三角形底部与带量突破颈线
patterns.name_en: Contracting-triangle bottom and volume-backed neckline breakout
patterns.structure: A prolonged base or narrowing triangle has a descending upper neckline and rising lower boundary; the upward break confirms the bottom. 台积电's approximately eight-month 16.67–25.79 range resolves upward on 2003-05-31 (pp183, 185). 金宝 first clears the smaller base neckline on 2001-10-27, then the larger triangle neckline on December 8 (p188).
patterns.entry: Enter the volume-backed small-base neckline break; 金宝 around 7.5 on October 27. Add around 9.7 when the larger neckline breaks on December 8 (p188). 台积电's 2003 breakout confirms a bull phase but no entry price is specified (p185). 茂矽's prior triangle-bottom breakout entry is approximately 295 on 1999-09-04 (p182, continuation).
patterns.stop: A fall back below the broken neckline invalidates the long; 金宝 quotes approximately 7% risk for both initial and add-on positions without an exact numerical stop (p188). 茂矽 uses 267, the breakout week's long bullish candle low, risk about 9% (p182).

target.formula: Triangle upside target = breakout neckline + vertical distance from the low to the upper neckline at the measuring location.
target.worked_example: 金宝: 12.8 - 6.08 = 6.72; 9.8 + 6.72 = 16.52 (p188). 茂矽's continuation gives a first target of 545 and a second of 545 + 255 = 800 (p182); the initial height derivation is outside this unit.

confirmation: Long bullish candles with volume confirm both 金宝 neckline breaks (p188).
金宝's later base is over ten months old, matching the earlier top's scale and making a large bull swing more likely (p188).
台积电's long bullish candle breaks the consolidation's upper neckline (p185).
invalidation: Return below the breakout neckline triggers the stated stop (pp182, 188).

patterns.structure: 台积电 consolidates at high levels around the first large-swing target for about half a year; a large bearish weekly candle breaks the triangle's lower neckline. The measuring height is from approximately 51 to the neckline at approximately 39.5, while the actual break is approximately 42.5 (pp183–184).
patterns.entry: Short after the large bearish neckline break on 2000-07-21; the operation paragraph says around 42 but misprints the year as 2002 (pp183–185).
patterns.stop: Approximately 44, above the neckline and at the bearish signal candle's high; approximately 5% risk. Cover if price regains this resistance (p185).

target.formula: Height H = triangle high - neckline at the measuring location; T1 = neckline at the breakdown - H; T2 = T1 - H after consolidation resolves downward.
target.worked_example: 51 - 39.5 = 11.5; 42.5 - 11.5 = 31; 31 - 11.5 = 19.5 (p184). The chart's exact peak label is 51.42, but the book's arithmetic intentionally uses approximately 51 (p183).

confirmation: The large bearish candle breaking the neckline establishes the top (pp183–184).
Following the first target, the text describes roughly two months of consolidation before another decline, then a September 2001 breakdown and three more months to the second target (p184).
invalidation: Regain the neckline/44 stop and exit the short (p185).
After reaching the second target, 台积电 makes a direct V reversal and reclaims the neckline, ending that bearish sequence (p184).

patterns.structure: A head above its shoulders becomes a confirmed top only after a neckline break. 茂矽 first forms an M top and then a composite head-and-shoulders top (p182). 台积电's head is approximately 42.1, neckline measuring value 34.9, and break value 36 (p185); 友达's head is 49.21, neckline measuring value 35.5, and break value 36 (pp189–190).
patterns.entry: Short the confirming weekly neckline break: 茂矽 2000-09-09 around 530 (p182); 台积电 2002-06-08 around 34.5 (p186); 友达 2004-06-12 around 35 after the break of 36 (p190).
patterns.stop: Exit if price regains neckline resistance: 茂矽 563, also the signal week's high, risk about 6% (p182); 台积电 approximately 36, risk about 4.3% (p186); 友达 above 36, described as approximately 5% risk (p190).

target.formula: H = head (or central mean of head highs) - neckline at the measuring location; T1 = actual neckline breakdown level - H; T2 = T1 - H where a second wave is explicitly supplied.

confirmation: A long bearish weekly candle confirms the neckline breakdown in 茂矽 and 台积电 (pp182, 185–186).
台积电 reaches 29.37, rebounds to 34.14 to complete an escape-line rally, then declines again (p185).
友达 reaches the calculated downside target region and stabilizes at 22.19 (p190).
invalidation: A return above the specified neckline stop ends the short (pp182, 186, 190).
茂矽's later volume-backed bullish reclaim confirms a bottom; 台积电's later triangle-bottom breakout begins a new bull phase (pp182, 185).

patterns.name_zh: 高档假突破与头部、底部规模比较
patterns.name_en: High-level false breakout followed by top confirmation and base-scale filtering
patterns.structure: 金宝 breaks the upper neckline in February 2000 but falls back below it, establishing a false breakout and long-term sell signal. A head-and-shoulders neckline break on July 29 confirms the larger top (p187). A subsequent reclaim with only a little-over-two-month base is much smaller than the over-ten-month top and is classified as a short rebound (pp187–188).
patterns.entry: Short once the false breakout is established on 2000-02-21, around 22.9; add on the July 29 neckline break, around 16 (p188).
patterns.stop: Initial short: regain the upper neckline at 24.4, risk approximately 6.5%. Add-on: regain 16.7, risk approximately 5%; the original high-entry short takes profit while the lower add-on stops out (p188).

target.formula: The subsequent confirmed head-and-shoulders top supplies the measured downside target: breakdown neckline - (head - measuring neckline).

confirmation: Failure back below the upper neckline confirms the false breakout (p187).
The July 29 lower-neckline break confirms the head-and-shoulders top (p187).
The early-2001 reclaim rallies sharply for three weeks but then resumes long bearish consolidation; a genuinely large bottom is described only in October 2001 (pp187–188).
invalidation: Regain the relevant short stop/neckline and exit (p188).
The later volume-backed October and December 2001 base-neckline breaks are long signals, not reasons to retain the original bearish thesis (p188).

patterns.name_zh: 长期底部突破与旗形整理再突破
patterns.name_en: Long-base neckline breakout followed by a flag continuation
patterns.structure: 光磊's three-year-four-month base is confirmed by the volume-backed long bullish weekly candle on 2006-04-15. Its downward-sloping neckline is measured near 16.2 above the 5.08 low, but the actual breakout is near 15.5. A neckline retest lasts about half a year; after reaching the first target, a flag consolidates for over three months before its upper edge breaks on 2007-03-04 (p191).
patterns.entry: The April 15 volume-backed neckline break establishes the bottom; the March 4 flag-upper-edge break authorizes the second-wave target. This unit's page does not give an entry price (p191).
patterns.stop: No numerical trading stop is stated on p191; the operations paragraph continues in the next unit.

target.formula: H = base neckline at the measuring location - bottom; T1 = breakout neckline + H; a renewed flag breakout permits T2 = T1 + H.
target.worked_example: 16.2 - 5.08 = 11.12; 15.5 + 11.12 = 26.62. The chart labels the second target 37.74 (p191); its explicit second-wave arithmetic continues outside this unit.

confirmation: Volume-backed long bullish candle confirms the multi-year bottom (p191).
A flag-upper-edge break after more than three months of consolidation confirms continuation (p191).
invalidation: No explicit invalidation rule is provided on p191; the long neckline-retest duration is noted as unusual, not itself classified as failure.

rules.rule: Only calculate the next upside wave after consolidation is followed by a new breakout; 茂矽's second target repeats the same 255-point distance.
rules.quote_zh: 整理后再度突破整理区高点，便能计算第二波涨幅满足。

rules.rule: 茂矽's first target 545 plus the original 255 distance yields the second target 800; do not replace this printed arithmetic with estimates.
rules.quote_zh: 第一波涨幅满足545元＋255元＝等幅满足计算的第二波涨幅满足800元。

rules.rule: Use a broken neckline as short resistance; 茂矽's stop is also the breakdown week's high.
rules.quote_zh: 停损设在563元，也就是站回颈线反压，也是当周长黑高点，风险约6%

rules.rule: For 台积电's upside swing target, add the first low-to-high rise to the correction low after the prior high is exceeded.
rules.quote_zh: 自23.4元低点＋20元＝等幅计算的涨幅满足43.4元。

rules.rule: A contracting triangle becomes a confirmed top only after the neckline breaks; its measuring height is the triangle edge length, projected below the actual breakdown.
rules.quote_zh: 当收敛三角形颈线跌破头部确立后，便可计算跌幅满足。计算方式：三角形边长＝跌破颈线后的等长。

rules.rule: The second triangle downside target repeats the same height below the first target.
rules.quote_zh: 第一波跌幅满足点31元再减11.5元＝等幅计算的跌幅满足19.5元。

rules.rule: 台积电's reclaimed-bottom long uses the large bullish week's low as support and holds toward the target while that support remains intact.
rules.quote_zh: 停损设在12.5元，也就是当周大量长红低点支撑，风险约6%，支撑不破，看涨幅满足附近

rules.rule: After a neckline breakdown, a rally that fails to regain it is an escape-line rally, not a reclaimed bull structure.
rules.quote_zh: 跌破颈线后反弹未站回颈线称之为逃命线（粉色箭头部分）

rules.rule: Weekly swing trading requires patience: in 台积电's roughly five-year example only a few clear buy and sell turning points occur.
rules.quote_zh: 操作波段要有耐心，机会是等出来的。

rules.rule: Breaking an upper neckline then falling back below it confirms a false breakout and a long-term sell signal.
rules.quote_zh: 金宝2000年2月突破上缘颈线又跌回破线，假突破确立长线卖出信号

rules.rule: Compare base duration with preceding top duration: 金宝's little-over-two-month reclaim base versus an over-ten-month top is treated as a short rebound despite its large amplitude.
rules.quote_zh: 远小于头肩顶十个多月的头部规模，通常短线反弹视之（但因跌深弹幅也达倍数）

rules.rule: A later base already over ten months old makes a substantial bull swing more likely; 金宝's subsequent larger-triangle break permits measuring the upside target.
rules.quote_zh: 此时对应年初低点底部规模已达十个多月，较易有大波段多头走势

rules.rule: Manage initial shorts and breakdown add-ons separately when price regains the add-on neckline: the high-entry short takes profit and the lower add-on stops out.
rules.quote_zh: 站回颈线16.7元之上，停损利点风险约5%（假突破高档空单停利，破线加码空单停损）

rules.rule: 友达's reclaim stop uses the pre-breakdown range floor 10.68, identified as the main player's cost area, not the new low 9.88.
rules.quote_zh: 停损设破底前低点10.68元跌破后（破底前的区间才是主力成本区），风险约8%

rules.rule: 友达's broken 36 neckline changes from support into resistance: cover the short if price regains it, otherwise hold toward 22.29.
The duration of a post-breakout retest can be substantial: 光磊 retests its neckline for approximately half a year, described as unusually long.
rules.quote_zh: 只是突破颈线后的回测颈线时间为少见的约半年之久。

rules.rule: A renewed break of the flag's upper boundary permits calculation of 光磊's second upside wave.
rules.quote_zh: 突破旗形整理上缘，便可计算第二波涨幅满足。

worked_examples.instrument: 茂矽 (continuation; ticker not stated on this unit's page)
worked_examples.pattern: Triangle-bottom breakout → second upside wave → M/composite head-and-shoulders top
worked_examples.outcome: Long entered on 1999-09-04; first target region in February 2000 and second in early April, quoted gains approximately 84% and 170%. The large bearish neckline break on 2000-09-09 confirms the composite top; reaches the downside target region by year-end, then two weeks of consolidation and a volume-backed bullish reclaim confirm a bottom. Quoted short profit approximately 63%. The prior chart/initial target derivation is outside this unit.

worked_examples.pattern: 破底翻 → large-swing upside equal distance
worked_examples.outcome: 1998-08-29 breaks the floor, 1998-11-21 volume-backed bullish reclaim confirms the bottom. First swing high on 1999-06-26, then correction; 1999-09-04 exceeds 30.5 and authorizes the 43.4 target. Reaches target region in late January 2000 and overshoots to approximately 51. Exposition quotes approximately 220% profit; the operation paragraph quotes approximately 226% (not reconciled).

worked_examples.pattern: Contracting-triangle top → two downside waves → V reversal
worked_examples.outcome: Chart and exposition date the confirming long bearish candle 2000-07-21; operation paragraph prints 2002-07-21. After first-target-centered consolidation, a September 2001 lower-boundary break reaches the second target about three months later. A direct V reversal reclaims the neckline and rises to 42.11. Quoted short gains near first/second targets approximately 26%/53%.

worked_examples.pattern: Head-and-shoulders top → two downside waves → contracting-triangle bottom
worked_examples.outcome: 2002-06-08 long bearish neckline break confirms the top. First decline bottoms in the week of July 6 at 29.37, rallies to 34.14 without reclaiming the neckline, then falls again. After the second target region, approximately eight months of base building; 2003-05-31 long bullish candle breaks the upper boundary and confirms a triangle bottom. Quoted short gains approximately 15% and 36%.

worked_examples.pattern: High-level false breakout → head-and-shoulders neckline breakdown
worked_examples.outcome: False-breakout short on 2000-02-21; add on the 2000-07-29 neckline break. Reaches downside target region near early-2001 low 6.08; quoted short profit at least 50%. A little-over-two-month reclaim base produces a three-week sharp rebound, then resumes prolonged bearish consolidation, rather than cancelling the larger top solely because the bounce is large.

worked_examples.pattern: Volume-backed small-neckline break → large contracting-triangle neckline break
worked_examples.outcome: 2001-10-27 volume-backed long bullish candle confirms the small base; over ten months of bottom formation supports a large bull-swing interpretation. Add on December 8 at the larger triangle neckline break. Reaches target region in April 2002, high 16.96, then tops and turns bearish. Quoted gains approximately 70%–120%; numerical stop prices are not supplied, only neckline failure and approximately 7% risk.

worked_examples.pattern: 破底翻 → prior-high breakout → large-swing upside target
worked_examples.outcome: p189 prints a 2002-05-31 weekly reclaim; p190 gives a 2003-05-26 daily reclaim followed by May 31 weekly confirmation. Preserve the mismatch. The 2004-02-21 long bullish prior-high breakout permits 44.77; reaches target region by mid-April and reverses less than three weeks later. Target-region profit approximately 286%, stated profit/risk ratio 35; earlier 11/17 daily trendline break offers an exit around 26.5 with quoted approximately 128% profit.

2004-06-12 breaks the neckline; below-36 resistance supports the short. Reaches target region in the week of 2004-11-06 at 22.19, stabilizes and builds a bottom before rising again. Quoted short profit approximately 36%.

worked_examples.instrument: 光磊 (2340; example begins here and continues in u15c)
worked_examples.pattern: Multi-year bottom neckline breakout → flag continuation
worked_examples.outcome: 2006-04-15 volume-backed long bullish neckline break confirms a three-year-four-month base. Retest lasts about half a year. First target region in early 2007, then more than three months of flag consolidation; 2007-03-04 upper-boundary break permits a second target. The chart shows later top/breakdown levels but this page's prose has not yet explained their arithmetic or trading stops.

quantifiable: Candidate reclaim detector: a weekly undercut of an established floor followed by a bullish reclaim of the floor/neckline; flag whether volume expands and record the signal-candle low as a possible stop. This is an operational interpretation, not a specified numerical volume threshold (pp183, 185, 189–190).

For a swing-continuation long, wait for price to exceed the prior swing high, then T = correction_low + (prior_high - originating_low); exact examples are 台积电 23.4 + (30.5 - 10.5) = 43.4 and 友达 23.77 + (30.88 - 9.88) = 44.77 (pp183, 189).

For sloping-neckline triangles, store two neckline coordinates: the value at the height measurement and the value at the breakout. 台积电 uses 39.5 for height but 42.5 for the downward projection; 金宝 uses 12.8 for height but 9.8 for the upward projection (pp184, 188).

For confirmed head-and-shoulders tops, T1 = breakdown_neckline - (head_reference - measuring_neckline); repeat the same height for T2 only when the example explicitly supplies a second wave (pp182, 185, 190).

Candidate escape-line classification: after breaking a neckline, a rally fails to regain that neckline and rolls over. The text defines the relation but not touch tolerance or required duration (pp185–186).

A conditional second-wave state can require consolidation near T1 followed by a break of the consolidation boundary in the original direction; 茂矽 upward continuation and 光磊's flag give examples (pp182, 191).

Compare elapsed base duration with preceding top duration; 金宝's about-two-month base versus over-ten-month top is rebound-only, while a later over-ten-month base supports a large bull swing. No universal ratio is specified (pp187–188).
Model original and add-on positions with different entry/stop levels: 金宝 initial short 22.9/24.4, add-on 16/16.7; reclaiming 16.7 realizes profit on one and loss on the other (p188).

Compute displayed price risk from entry and stop for audit, but retain the author's approximate figures separately; stops include bullish-candle lows, bearish-candle highs, prior range floors, and reclaimed necklines (pp182, 185–186, 188, 190).
ambiguities: p182 is a continuation of 茂矽: its chart and initial measured-height derivation are outside u15b. Only the printed 545, 255, 800 and later head/neckline calculation can be verified here (p182).
台积电's triangle-top chart and exposition say 2000-07-21 (pp183–184), but the operation paragraph says 2002-07-21 (p185). The notes preserve rather than repair the date conflict.

台积电 uses rounded 51 for its triangle calculation, while the chart labels 51.42; prose second-target low 18.8 versus chart 18.83 and head reference 42.1 versus chart 42.11 are separate printed values, not silently interchangeable (pp183–185).

台积电's post-first-target consolidation is described as low 24.56/high 36.91, while the displayed intermediate triangle labels are 22.45 and 30.67; the page does not explain the relationship of these distinct ranges (pp183–184).

台积电's exposition uses entry near 13, exit near 42 and approximately 220% profit, while the operation paragraph uses entry 13.3 and approximately 226% near the 43.4 target. These are separately rounded trade descriptions, not one uniform entry/exit pair (pp184–185).

友达's title says 2002–2004 and p189 dates the reclaim 2002-05-31, whereas p190 specifies 2003-05-26 daily reclaim followed by May 31 weekly confirmation; chart axis includes later data through 2005. No outside calendar lookup used to repair these dates (pp189–190).
友达's 11/17 daily trendline exit omits a year and uses a daily chart not reproduced here; record the quoted 26.5/128% only (p190).
友达's short entry 35 and neckline stop 36 imply roughly 2.9% price distance, while the text says approximately 5%; it may allow stop tolerance but no exact adjusted stop is specified (p190).

Terms such as volume-backed, long bullish/bearish candle, target vicinity, confirmed breakout and support not broken have no numerical thresholds, closing-versus-intrabar rule, or execution convention in these pages (pp182–191).

Bottom/top duration is used qualitatively to infer swing scale, not as a calibrated statistical guarantee; no general minimum duration or ratio is given (pp187–188). 金宝's upside-height calculation uses the earlier 6.08 low even though the later chart labels lows at 5.87/5.92; the book does not explain why it retains the earlier measurement anchor (pp187–188).
光磊's p191 begins a case that continues in u15c. Only the chart supplies 37.74 and later top levels here; no numeric trade entry/stop or detailed short procedure appears on this page (p191).
